record.question: You will be healthy as long as you maintain your diet. Pick out the correct clause of the underlined words.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. “As long as you maintain your diet” gives a condition, so it is an adverb clause. Independent check: “As long as you maintain your diet” expresses the condition for being healthy. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conditionals.
